issues.on_page: General government (heading on p2 Statement of Activities)
issues.issue: All spending is recorded as general government because the p2 heading says so. A reclamation (irrigation/drainage) district's field materials, distribution-works repairs and similar costs could instead be natural resources/conservation, which the rules give for water and drainage districts. This is a judgment call. All amounts, the totals (receipts 90,677, disbursements 104,288), the roll-forward 218,475 -> 204,864 and the balance sheet (329,268) tie to pp1-3. Read pages 1-4 of 4.
